g.text: 05 / Measured execution cost, not a hardware benchmark

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #b0c1b9

g.text: Five primary variants only; 98/98 jobs each, no failures. Complete component walltime includes loading, fit and I/O.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #b0c1b9

g.text: RSS is an observed sampled peak. Shared-host serial CPU execution; no GPU measurements or estimated CPU-time conversion.
